title: Reverse Call Tree (clickable, Messages window)
summary: The same reverse call tree, rendered into the IDE's Messages window so each line navigates to the caller
intro: Read this when you want to click through the callers of a symbol instead of reading a flat report: the IDE shows the reverse call tree in the Messages window, and each line jumps to the caller.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint reverse-calltree --qname <X> [--direction callers|callees] [--depth N] [--format text|json|dot|mermaid] [--json] --db PATH [--db ...] (N-deep call tree; callers=who calls X (default), callees=what X calls; cycle-guarded)

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Reverse Call Tree (who calls this, N-deep)...
steps: Put the caret on the routine in the editor
Choose drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Reverse Call Tree (who calls this, N-deep)...
The callers appear in the Messages window; double-click a line to open that caller

questions.ask: Who calls this routine, and can I jump to each caller?
questions.command: drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Reverse Call Tree (who calls this, N-deep)...

notes: No menu item of its own since 2026-09-07: drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Reverse Call Tree (who calls this, N-deep)... asks where to render, and Yes picks the Messages window
